source_review.notes: Checked current AWS Builders' Library load-shedding/smaller-service-control guidance, Google SRE Handling Overload and Cascading Failures, current Envoy Overload Manager documentation, RFC 9110 and the cited queueing, performance and controlled-delay sources. Platform shed points/signals remain explicitly version qualified.

evidence: Checked offered/admitted/service rates, shed fraction, weighted cost rate, signal vector, high/low thresholds, state and goodput notation.
Checked uniform fraction, goodput, Little's-Law and hysteresis expressions.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Raw throughput, accepted work and useful on-time outcomes remain distinct.

evidence: Reproduced executable pressures 650,820,920,850,680; state trace normal,normal,shedding,shedding,normal; optional shed only in shedding while critical remains admitted.
Recomputed Exercise 3 residents 700 times 0.1 = 70 and 700 times 1.2 = 840, a twelve-fold increase.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Uniform calculations omit cost mix, rejection overhead, signal lag and changing capacity.

evidence: Verified ideal f >= 1-mu/lambda implies admitted rate no greater than mu under homogeneous negligible-rejection assumptions.
Verified persistent admitted rate above service grows a fluid backlog and a finite queue eventually fills.
Verified hysteresis prevents signal movement strictly within (L,H) from toggling state and non-admission proves no protected effect only before issue.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Goodput preservation and priority protection are conditional on cheap rejection, correct signals, finite authenticated critical work and residual capacity.

evidence: Reviewed exact/noisy high/low thresholds, stale/missing sensors, activation lag, dwell/ramp, cold recovery and fleet synchronization.
Reviewed connection/header/body/queue/dependency shed points, count/byte/age bounds, deadline feasibility, expensive/issued work and ambiguous effects.
Reviewed criticality forgery/starvation, weighted cost, stable/random cohorts, retries/failover, fallback truth, attack, control-plane failure and safety-critical command/telemetry behavior.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Real workload knee, platform resources, fairness, security and safety require load/fault evidence and named review.

evidence: Traced named local protection, cheap independent shed path, early admission, separate accounting, authenticated finite criticality and finite queues throughout.
Traced effect reconciliation, retry ownership, hysteretic recovery and protected-goodput evidence through examples/answers.
invariant_checking.notes: Rejection counts alone are explicitly rejected as a completion oracle.

evidence: Reviewed ideal admission bound, queue-instability, conditional goodput, hysteresis, priority and no-rollback arguments against stated premises.
Confirmed counterexamples for CPU-only sensing, late shedding, unbounded critical work and shared residual resources.
Confirmed capacity/fairness/safety claims require empirical and human evidence.
proof_review.notes: No formal proof of a controller, queueing distribution, production capacity, security property or safety case is claimed.

evidence: Audited sustainable, overload, goodput, critical, fair, available, degraded, safe, guarantee and proof language.
Confirmed deterministic policy, empirical capacity curve, authoritative/degraded outcomes and external review are separated.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Shedding is presented as controlled partial non-admission, not an availability or rollback proof.

evidence: artifacts/snippets/SEPAT-086/report.json
Reproduced fixed pressure/state/optional/critical traces and 37.5% arithmetic using Python 3.
Confirmed no resource measurement, concurrency, queues, authentication, retries, effects or load was executed.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Execution establishes one sequential branch trace only.

conceptual_review.notes: The chapter treats Load Shedding as goodput-preserving overload admission with explicit criticality and recovery, not random errors or static rate limiting.

practitioner_review.notes: Guidance covers multidimensional signals, progressive shed points, goodput/deadlines, cost/fairness/security, reject/degrade/defer, retry/upstream control, hysteresis/recovery, telemetry and beyond-knee tests.

pedagogical_review.notes: Objectives align with conditional proofs, executable hysteresis trace, ten distinct cases and five exercises progressing from design through arithmetic, residency, diagnosis and safety-critical judgment.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
